ACCUMULATED_NARRATIVE:  
Alex’s day unfolded under a cloud of subdued affect and interpersonal friction. She guarded her voice, retreating inward when her contributions went undervalued, yet her moderate emotional stability prevented deeper distress. Moments of manager support offered brief reprieve, but the day’s texture was one of cautious endurance rather than enthusiasm. By day’s end, Alex craved solitude to restore equilibrium before facing another workday.
